subject: A 360° student profile for Goldcrest International (IGCSE), Vashi
text:
Dear Principal,

Schools are moving beyond marks towards a complete, 360° picture of every learner, as NEP 2020 encourages. For most teachers, collecting and reporting this by hand for every student takes many hours.

CampusOne, a Navi Mumbai school software company, has built a 360° Student Profile and Holistic Progress system that makes this simple for Goldcrest International (IGCSE):

- One digital profile per student: academics, skills, values, interests, health and teacher feedback
- Self, peer, teacher and parent inputs brought together in one progress report
- Teachers enter an activity once for the whole class, then set each student's level on one screen
- Parents and students fill their own sections from their phone, straight into the teacher's screen
- Term-by-term growth charts, and reports with your school's name that print in one click

It works alongside your board's own report card, so nothing in your current assessment has to change.

You can read more about the system, and why schools are moving to 360° student profiles, in this article on First Education News:

https://firsteducationnews.com/article.asp?id=65618

Many schools are setting this up during Term 2 so parents see the new profile at the year-end.

May I show you a free 20-minute demo at your school this week? We can also run a free 30-day pilot with one class so your teachers can try it first.

Please reply with a convenient day, or call or WhatsApp me on 98673 81971.

Regards,
Team CampusOne
CampusOne Education Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
98673 81971 | 88500 93759 | info@campusone.in | https://campusone.in/

If you would rather not receive emails from us, just reply "No thanks" and we will not write again.
